'''Feral Horses''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Version]] of Horses. Its slightly recognizable from its original form, although just barely, as its maw has split all the way to the start of its torso.<ref>Truly a ''fearsome fate.''</ref> Like other [[Feral Parasites]], most of its body is a fleshy red, and tentacles emerge from the [[Gnat]] in its mouth.

==''Spawning''==

* Spawned when a Horse is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from a Horse succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Horse]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 3 Horses have been assimilated.

==''Behavior''==
Feral Horses are Melee Combatants.

* Feral Horses attack through contact damage.
* Feral Horses can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Feral Horses are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On hit Feral Horse has a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].

===''Weaknesses''===
*Feral Horses, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death Feral Horses have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death they have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
